nodes.description: msg.sender - externally controlled caller address used for authorization and token movement
owner - privileged address set in constructor, used as sole authorization gate
balanceOf mapping - ledger of token balances, mutated in transferFrom and _mints
allowance mapping - spender approvals, mutated in approve and transferFrom
tradeAddress - privileged address that bypasses ensure() checks, set by owner
canSale mapping - per-address flag that bypasses sale restrictions in ensure()
_onSaleNum mapping - per-address counters incremented on each transferFrom
_minSale - minimum sale amount configured via init()
_maxSale - maximum sale amount configured via init()
_saleNum - per-address sale counter limit configured via init()
totalSupply - total token supply, set in constructor and adjusted by mint/burn
_balances - internal balance mapping of the base ERC20 implementation
_allowances - internal nested allowance mapping of the base ERC20 implementation
a.delegatecall(b) - arbitrary delegatecall to a caller-supplied address with caller-supplied payload, executing untrusted code in this contract's storage context
address(token).call(data) - low-level external call in SafeERC20.callOptionalReturn that forwards return data and enables callback reentrancy
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total - unchecked subtraction without SafeMath in batchSend
balanceOf[_from] -= _value - unchecked subtraction without SafeMath in transferFrom
transfer(address,uint) - payable public entry point that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,...)
transferFrom(address,uint,uint) - payable public token movement with allowance, ensure, and unchecked balance arithmetic
approve(address,uint) - payable public allowance setter for msg.sender
ensure(address,address,uint) - internal gate with hardcoded whitelist bypass for owner/UNI/tradeAddress/canSale addresses
condition(address,uint) - internal sale restriction checks against _saleNum/_minSale/_maxSale
delegate(address,bytes) - payable public owner-only function performing delegatecall to an arbitrary address
_mints(address,uint) - public mint that whitelists several hardcoded addresses and assigns arbitrary balance
init(uint,uint,uint) - owner-only setter of sale parameters
batchSend(address[],uint) - owner-only batch distribution using unchecked multiplication and subtraction
setTradeAddress(address) - owner-only setter of the privileged tradeAddress that bypasses ensure()
constructor(string,string,uint) - payable deploy-time initialization setting owner and supply
pairFor(address,address,address) - pure internal helper computing a Uniswap pair address via keccak256
_transfer(address,address,uint) - internal ERC20 transfer using SafeMath on _balances
_approve(address,address,uint) - internal ERC20 allowance writer
_mint(address,uint) - internal supply and balance increase via SafeMath
_burn(address,uint) - internal supply and balance decrease via SafeMath
callOptionalReturn(IERC20,bytes) - private helper that verifies isContract and then performs a low-level call
isContract(address) - extcodehash check used to validate the call target
_from - source address parameter of CFXT.transferFrom, checked against whitelists and debited
_to - destination address parameter of CFXT.transferFrom, credited
_value - amount parameter of CFXT.transferFrom, compared and subtracted
_tos - recipient array parameter of batchSend, controls loop and multiplication
total - local variable in batchSend computed as _value * _tos.length without SafeMath
i - loop counter local variable in batchSend
a - target address parameter of delegate(), the delegatecall destination
b - calldata parameter of delegate(), the delegatecall payload
spender - address parameter of _mints receiving an arbitrary balance
addedValue - amount parameter of _mints scaled by 10**decimals
addr - address parameter of setTradeAddress stored into privileged tradeAddress
sender - debited address parameter of ERC20._transfer
recipient - credited address parameter of ERC20._transfer
amount - transferred amount parameter of ERC20._transfer
